PDF Projecting Tetrahedra without Rendering Artifacts
ABSTRACT Hardware-accelerated direct volume rendering of unstructured vol-umetric meshes is often based on tetrahedral cell projection, in par-ticular, the Projected Tetrahedra (PT) algorithm and its variants. Unfortunately, even implementations of the most advanced variants of the PT algorithm are very prone to rendering artifacts.
